chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: Correcting the order: Lyric, then Marable's boat, then St. Louis
summary: Dance corrects the bio: Zutty went from the Orchard and Cadillac to the Lyric, was hired out of the Lyric by Fate Marable, then left the boats and went back to the Lyric before Creath called him.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I've got it, I've got it. And then after the navy we've got that. So now, the navy, the Lyric Theater, no wait a second. No you were on the river boats before you went into the, were you on the river boats before you went into the Lyric Theater?

No, I got hired out of the Lyric Theater to go on the ......... But before then I'd been with Louis at the Orchard. And from the Orchard I went to the Cadillac and that's when I went into the Lyric Theater.

Yes, well he's got this all wrong. You see, he's got with Fate Marable from '21 until '23. Then left the river boats to return to New Orleans. Did pit orchestra work for John Robicheaux then moved to St. Louis." But actually....
Well that's what happened, because I left the boats and I went back in the Lyric Theater.
Yes. You see, and then when Charlie Creath Kirk wanted me to come to St. Louis that was it.
Yes. Well now how did you come we haven't got the river boats. How did you come to go on the river boats? This is really it, when we've done this.

Well, that's what I told you It gets around when you're going to go on that boat. You go into the conservatory, see that's what they out. Said, old Zutty's going to the conservatory man, see. And that's how I got on the boat. Because they liked the way I played.
He heard you at the Lyric?
Yes, heard me at the Lyric Theater.
And he invited me to take the job on the boat.
